QuestInfo.name: A Suspicious Bowman
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce, the Bowman Job Instructor, wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce, the Bowman Job Instructor, wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce asks you if you know Tess. Tess always keeps his face hidden, and his skills are too good for someone who just advanced his job. She think he might be someone she knows and wants you to keep an eye out for him.

0.0: Thank you for coming. Do you remember when you first came to Victoria Island? Do you remember any of the others on the boat trip with you from Maple Island to Lith Harbor?
0.1: No? That's unfortunate. \r\nYou're probably curious why I'm asking.
0.2: Someone who took a Bowman Job Advancement test recently seemed rather... suspicious. For starters, he was wearing a mask. He said he was sick, but he didn't seem ill...
0.3: On top of that, usually people who take the test aren't very strong, but...
0.4: He was obviously a battle-hardened veteran. Why would someone like him take a Job Advancement test?
0.5: I don't mean to scare you. He seemed suspicious, but not dangerous...
0.6: I haven't heard anything about him since then. I just wonder who he is, what he's doing, and why he felt he needed to hide his identity from me.
0.7: His name was #bTess#k. If you ever run into him, could you tell him I'd love to talk to him?

no.0: No? I thought you'd understand the yearning to meet an old friend...

yes.0: Thank you.\r\nI hope that Tess will listen to you, should you ever run into him.
